{{Quote|Crusader's schism. What they called the war between the clans.|[[Torian Cadera]]|<ref name="TOR:Kinship" />}}
The '''Crusader's schism''',<ref name="TOR:Kinship" /> also known as the '''Mandalorian Schism''',<ref name="TOR:TMS" /> was a conflict within the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Holonet" /> Some of the clans, including [[Clan Ordo|Clans Ordo]], [[Clan Itera|Itera]], [[Clan Kelborn|Kelborn]], and [[Clan Cadera|Cadera]],<ref name="TOR:Kinship" /> wanted to support the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] as [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] had [[Dark Wars|centuries prior]],<ref name="Holonet" /> and [[Jicoln Cadera]] led an uprising against the acting [[Mandalore the Vindicated|Mandalore]].<ref name="TOR:TMS" /> They were unsuccessful, and Mandalore crushed the faction in his quest to unite the Mandalorian clans under his banner and went on to support the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Holonet" /> Mandalore seized the [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armors]] of the surviving rebels and had their children adopted into other clans. Jicoln Cadera escaped into exile.<ref name="TOR:TMS" />
